sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Hungarian usually marks plural nouns with -k. The form of the noun may change before the suffix.

items.spanish: Az új könyvek és a régi könyvek.
items.english: The new books and the old books.

items.spanish: A nagy asztalok és a kicsi székek.
items.english: The big tables and the small chairs.

sections.content: Only the noun takes the plural -k — az új könyvek, not az újak könyvek. The adjective új stays exactly as it is; all the marking happens on könyv. That division of labor, invariant adjective and inflected noun, holds throughout the sentence whenever the adjective comes before the noun.
